hops.title: Compare it: a bud is like a water bottle with its lid on
hops.text: Hand your child a water bottle with the lid screwed on tight. Shake it gently: nothing spills, and the lid takes the bumps. On a bare winter twig, the tiny scales wrapped around many buds do the same job, helping keep next spring's growth from drying out and getting bumped. Find a plump bud together, feet on the ground.

sources.citation: Purdue University Extension, HO-203: Effects of Cold Weather on Horticultural Plants in Indiana

image.alt: AI-generated illustration: A bare winter twig with a plump scaled bud beside a closed blue water bottle on a park bench.
image.caption: Tiny bud scales help keep next spring's growth from drying out, like a lid on a bottle.

hops.title: Point at it: leaf marks under maple buds
hops.text: On a bare maple, stand together beside a low twig, feet on the ground. Look just below a bud on the side of the twig. Where a leaf fell, the tree sealed a little mark, like a fingerprint. On many maples it is a V with three tiny dots, where tubes once carried water. Look closely, no pulling.

sources.citation: University of Kentucky Arboretum, The Fingerprints of Leaves (2023)

image.alt: AI-generated illustration: A parent and child seen from behind looking closely at a low bare maple twig with a side bud and a V-shaped leaf mark below it.
image.caption: On this maple, a V-shaped leaf mark with three tiny dots sits just below a side bud.

hops.title: Say it: the yellow was hiding all summer
hops.text: When your child spots a green leaf turning yellow on your tree, try this: "That yellow was hiding in our leaves all summer. It's the same color family as carrots and corn. Fall just took off the green cover." It turns a color change into a game of hide-and-seek.

sources.citation: USDA Forest Service, The Joy and Science of Fall Colors
USDA Forest Service, Hoosier National Forest, Autumn Splendor (2011)

image.alt: AI-generated illustration: A close-up maple leaf turning from green to bright yellow on a sunlit autumn branch.
image.caption: When the green fades, you can see the yellow that was there all summer.
